See you soon, {{first_name}}

Your table for {{party_size}} is confirmed for {{reservation_time}} at Eleanor's Tavern, 31-09 Broadway, Astoria.

subject: Your Eleanor's Tavern gift card receipt
html_content: Thank you for your purchase of a {{amount}} gift card. Card code: {{card_code}}.

subject: Your private event at Eleanor's Tavern is booked
html_content:
Booked, {{first_name}}!

Your {{event_type}} for {{guest_count}} guests on {{event_date}} in the {{space}} is confirmed. A deposit receipt is attached.

name: Reservation Reminder
subject: Reminder: your table at Eleanor's Tavern tomorrow
html_content: Just a friendly reminder about your reservation for {{party_size}} tomorrow at {{reservation_time}}.

name: Reservation Cancellation
subject: Your Eleanor's Tavern reservation has been cancelled
html_content: Your reservation for {{reservation_time}} has been cancelled. We hope to see you another time.

subject: Your wine tasting seats are confirmed
html_content: You're confirmed for {{session}} with {{seats}} seat(s). See you at the tavern!

subject: A table just opened up at Eleanor's Tavern, {{first_name}}
html_content: Good news, {{first_name}}! A table for {{party_size}} is now available at {{available_time}}. Reply within 15 minutes to claim it.

name: Newsletter Welcome
subject: Welcome to the Eleanor's Tavern table, {{first_name}}
html_content:
Welcome, {{first_name}}!

Thanks for joining our list. Expect seasonal menus, wine tastings, and the occasional pie recipe.

name: Private Event Inquiry Reply
subject: Thanks for your private event inquiry
html_content: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for asking about hosting your {{event_type}} with us. Sophia will follow up within one business day with availability and pricing.

name: Gift Card Delivery
subject: You've received an Eleanor's Tavern gift card!
html_content:
A gift for you, {{recipient_name}}

{{sender_name}} sent you a {{amount}} gift card. Use code {{card_code}} on your next visit.

name: Monthly Newsletter
subject: What's cooking this month at Eleanor's Tavern
html_content:
{{month}} at the Tavern

This month's specials, upcoming events, and a note from Carlton.

name: Birthday Offer
subject: Happy birthday from Eleanor's Tavern, {{first_name}}!
html_content: Happy birthday, {{first_name}}! Stop by this month for a complimentary slice of house-made apple pie. Just mention this email.

name: Patio Season Announcement
subject: Our patio opens for the spring season
html_content: Patio season is almost here. Reserve one of our 24 outdoor seats for dinner Tuesday through Sunday once the patio opens for the season.

name: Holiday Hours Notice
subject: Eleanor's Tavern holiday hours
html_content: Hi {{first_name}}, here are our hours for the upcoming holidays. As always, we're closed Mondays.

name: Review Request
subject: How was your visit to Eleanor's Tavern?
html_content: Thanks for dining with us, {{first_name}}. We'd love to hear how it went, leave us a quick review and help your neighbors find us.

name: Catering Quote
subject: Your Eleanor's Tavern catering quote
html_content: Hi {{first_name}}, attached is your catering quote for {{guest_count}} guests on {{event_date}}. Let us know if you'd like to adjust the menu.

name: Wine Club Update
subject: This quarter's wine club selections
html_content: Hi {{first_name}}, your {{quarter}} wine club bottles are ready. Pick them up at the tavern any day we're open.

name: Reservation No-Show Notice
subject: We missed you at Eleanor's Tavern
html_content: Hi {{first_name}}, we held your table for {{party_size}} but didn't see you. We hope everything is okay, feel free to rebook anytime.

name: Job Application Acknowledgment
subject: Thanks for applying to Eleanor's Tavern
html_content: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for your interest in the {{position}} role. We'll review your application and reach out if there's a fit.

name: Jazz Sundays Invite
subject: Live jazz this Sunday at Eleanor's Tavern
html_content: Join us this Sunday for live jazz and a special brunch menu. {{first_name}}, reserve your table early, these fill up fast.
